You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 8dff9808e9734fb5b4eddd0a5b1472fade215490 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "Andrea Parri (Microsoft)" <parri.andrea@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Feb 2021 12:35:13 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] hv_netvsc: Load and store the proper (NBL_HASH_INFO)
 per-packet info

Fix the typo.

Signed-off-by: Andrea Parri (Microsoft) <parri.andrea@gmail.com>
Fixes: 0ba35fe91ce34f ("hv_netvsc: Copy packets sent by Hyper-V out of the receive buffer")
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
---
 drivers/net/hyperv/rndis_filter.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/drivers/net/hyperv/rndis_filter.c b/drivers/net/hyperv/rndis_filter.c
index 6c48a4d62736..0c2ebe7ac655 100644
--- a/drivers/net/hyperv/rndis_filter.c
+++ b/drivers/net/hyperv/rndis_filter.c
@@ -465,7 +465,7 @@ void rsc_add_data(struct netvsc_channel *nvchan,
 		}
 		nvchan->rsc.pktlen = len;
 		if (hash_info != NULL) {
-			nvchan->rsc.csum_info = *csum_info;
+			nvchan->rsc.hash_info = *hash_info;
 			nvchan->rsc.ppi_flags |= NVSC_RSC_HASH_INFO;
 		} else {
 			nvchan->rsc.ppi_flags &= ~NVSC_RSC_HASH_INFO;
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a typo in the code where the wrong variable (`csum_info`) was being assigned to `nvchan->rsc.csum_info` instead of the intended variable (`hash_info`) being assigned to `nvchan->rsc.hash_info`. This resulted in incorrect handling of per-packet information related to hash values, which could lead to issues in packet processing and network performance.
